conditions.description: Contact P3, 2025: segment invoice payment mode Corporate, no corporate subscription for 2025 (only a 2024 one), paid position. RULE-025.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002: Corporate test is segment invoice Corporate plus a live corporate subscription that year. Standard set-up (SetUp fakes every table read or written and seeds payment methods 1-5 with Corporate = 5, payer types, concession types No concession 1 / Retired 2 / Exceptional Hardship 3, line types, campaign years 2021-2026). P3: invoice 900301 INV-P3-25 (2025, Corporate), one SUBS line 450.00; brnz_corporate_subscription row for 2024 only (Active/Active); silv_payment_events 'Fully Paid' 2025; one 2025 Renewal; attributes 2025 = payment 5, payer Individual 1, concession 1, segment invoice 900301.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, P3).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-001 Corporate segment invoice without a corporate subscription raises one CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME row]

conditions.description: Design: anomaly_nk is the contact number and Campaign Year; detail names the Campaign Year and the segment invoice.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002. Data as TC-008-001 (P3, invoice 900301 INV-P3-25, 2025). The exact text format of anomaly_nk and detail is left to the build.
conditions.expected: Exactly one CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME row for P3 whose anomaly_nk contains 'P3' and '2025', and whose detail contains '2025' and names the invoice ('INV-P3-25' or rec_id '900301').
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-002 anomaly_nk names the contact and year and detail names the year and segment invoice]

conditions.description: Contact P1, 2025: Corporate segment invoice and a live corporate subscription (SCH-001, Active/Active, 2025). No anomaly.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002, Q-027 (active value 'Active'). P1: invoice 900101 Corporate, SUBS 450.00; subscription SCH-001 2025 Active/Active live; paid 2025; attributes payment 5, payer Corporate 2, ref 'SCH-001'.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly is empty.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-003 Corporate segment invoice with a live corporate subscription raises no anomaly]

conditions.description: A corporate subscription row that is soft-deleted in bronze (_is_deleted = 1) is not live, so a Corporate segment invoice is still flagged.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002, Q-027. P12: invoice 901201 Corporate 2025; subscription SCH-012 2025 Active/Active with _is_deleted 1; paid 2025; attributes payment 5, payer Individual 1.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, P12).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-004 soft-deleted corporate subscription is not live and the flag is raised]

conditions.description: Only the segment invoice counts: an earlier 2025 invoice paid Corporate does not raise the flag when the latest (segment) invoice is Card.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002, Q-012 (latest eligible invoice sets the year). P13: invoice 901301 (2024-10-05, Corporate) and 901302 (2025-01-10, Card), each with a SUBS 450.00 line; no corporate subscription; paid 2025; attributes payment Card 2, segment invoice 901302.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly is empty.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-005 Corporate on an earlier non-segment invoice raises no flag]

conditions.description: Anomalies are derived for contact-years from 2022 only: a 2021 Corporate invoice without a subscription raises nothing, a 2022 one raises the flag.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002, Q-011. P14: 2021 invoice 901421 Corporate, attributes 2021 all -2, no segment invoice. P15: 2022 invoice 901522 Corporate, attributes 2022 payment 5, payer 1. Neither has a subscription; both have a paid position.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, P15). Nothing for P14.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-006 flag is raised for 2022 but not for 2021]

conditions.description: A year with no eligible invoice, whose Corporate payment method is only carried forward, has no segment invoice and raises no flag; the invoiced year does.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002, Q-006. P16: 2025 invoice 901625 Corporate, no subscription, paid 2025; no 2026 invoice. Attributes 2025 payment 5 not carried; 2026 payment 5 carried 1, payer 1 carried 1, no segment invoice. Events: 2025 Renewal, 2026 Lapse.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row, (CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, P16), and no row's anomaly_nk contains '2026'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-007 a carried-forward year with no invoice raises no flag]

conditions.description: Contact P7, 2025: Corporate segment invoice; the 2025 subscription has Sub Status 'Active' but Sub User Status 'Inactive', so it is not live.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002, Q-027. P7: invoice 900701 Corporate; subscription SCH-007 2025 Active/Inactive, live in bronze; paid 2025; attributes payment 5, payer Individual 1.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, P7).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-008 subscription with Sub User Status Inactive is not live and the flag is raised]

conditions.description: Contact P6, 2025: segment invoice settled 225.00 by Card and 225.00 by Corporate; P6 is in a live corporate subscription. RULE-026.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002, Q-027. P6: invoice 900601 (inv_payment_method Card, voucher V-P6-25) with SUBS 450.00; payment lines on P6's account with lastsettlevoucher V-P6-25: 225.00 'Card' and 225.00 'Corporate'; subscription SCH-006 2025 Active/Active; paid; attributes payment Card 2, payer Corporate 2, ref 'SCH-006'.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (DOUBLE_PAYMENT, P6). No CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-009 Card and Corporate settlement with a live subscription raises one DOUBLE_PAYMENT row]

conditions.description: Contact P8, 2025: segment invoice settled 225.00 by Card and 225.00 by Corporate; no live corporate subscription; paid position.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002. P8: invoice 900801 (Card, V-P8-25), SUBS 450.00; payment lines 225.00 'Card' and 225.00 'Corporate' settling V-P8-25 on P8's account; no subscription; paid; attributes payment Card 2, payer Individual 1.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (DOUBLE_PAYMENT, P8).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-010 Card and Corporate settlement without a live subscription raises one DOUBLE_PAYMENT row]

conditions.description: No double payment where the invoice is settled by one method only, or where the Corporate settlement line is soft-deleted (not live).
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002. P10: invoice 901001 settled 225.00 Card + 225.00 Card. P11: invoice 901101 settled 225.00 Card (live) + 225.00 Corporate with _is_deleted 1. Both paid, attributes payment Card 2, payer 1.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly is empty.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-011 single-method settlement and a soft-deleted Corporate payment raise no DOUBLE_PAYMENT]

conditions.description: A contact-year that meets both RULE-025 (Corporate segment invoice, no live subscription) and RULE-026 (settled by Corporate and Card) gets one row of each type, with distinct anomaly_nk values.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002. P17: invoice 901701 inv_payment_method Corporate, SUBS 450.00, settled 225.00 Card + 225.00 Corporate; no subscription; paid; attributes payment 5, payer Individual 1.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly (CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, P17) and (DOUBLE_PAYMENT, P17), with 2 distinct anomaly_nk values.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-012 Corporate invoice settled by Card and Corporate without a subscription raises both types once]

conditions.description: A second load on unchanged data adds no rows and leaves every existing anomaly row untouched (design: existing cases left untouched), and logs 0 inserted, 0 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.preconditions: Data for P3 (flag), P8 (double payment), K4 (CONUNKNOWN) and K5 (Full Concession, no concession line), as in TC-008-001, -010, -018 and -022. Load run once, snapshot of silv_data_anomaly (all columns) taken, etl_run_log cleared, load run again.
conditions.expected: First run leaves 4 rows. silv_data_anomaly after the second run is identical in every column to the snapshot. etl_run_log holds one row for the second run: status 'Success', rows_inserted 0, rows_updated 0, rows_deleted 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-013 rerun on unchanged data leaves every anomaly row untouched and logs 0 0 0]

conditions.description: Design: cases that no longer apply are deleted on the next run (for example after a correction); cases that still apply are left untouched.
conditions.preconditions: Data for P3 and P8 as TC-008-016. Load run once. Then P3 gains a live 2025 subscription SCH-003 (Active/Active) and its attributes become payer Corporate 2, ref 'SCH-003'. etl_run_log cleared; load run again.
conditions.expected: No silv_data_anomaly row remains for P3. P8's DOUBLE_PAYMENT row is identical in every column to before the rerun. etl_run_log: status 'Success', rows_inserted 0, rows_updated 0, rows_deleted 1.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-014 a case that no longer applies is removed and a still-valid case is untouched]

conditions.description: The load touches only its own four anomaly types: rows of Phase 1 types and of the invoice anomaly types are left as they were, including one for the same contact.
conditions.preconditions: silv_data_anomaly pre-loaded with NO_TRANSACTIONS for P3, EVENT_NO_INVOICE for P99 and a resolved JOIN_NO_PAYMENT for P98 (explicit timestamps). P3 data as TC-008-001.
conditions.expected: Rows of the other types are identical in every column before and after the run; exactly one CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME row exists for P3.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-015 anomaly rows of other types are left untouched]

conditions.description: Design logging: a successful run ends its etl_run_log row 'Success' with counts that agree with the rows written.
conditions.preconditions: P3 (flag) and P8 (double payment) data; empty silv_data_anomaly; etl_run_log faked with defaults.
conditions.expected: etl_run_log holds one row: status 'Success', rows_inserted 2, rows_updated 0, rows_deleted 0, error_message NULL, finished_at set.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-016 successful run logs Success with the rows inserted]

conditions.description: Error path (design: try/catch with XACT_ABORT, error recorded through usp_etl_log_end, re-raised): a write the target rejects re-raises, logs 'Failed' and leaves silv_data_anomaly unchanged.
conditions.preconditions: Runs without the tSQLt transaction. silv_data_anomaly holds a stale CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME row for PSTALE (a pending delete) and a NO_TRANSACTIONS row for P3. Corporate-without-subscription data for P3 and PERR (2025). A test-only CHECK on the faked silv_data_anomaly rejects contact_no 'PERR'.
conditions.expected: Error 547 reaches the caller. silv_data_anomaly is identical to before in every column (PSTALE row still there, no P3 or PERR row). etl_run_log holds one row, status 'Failed', with a non-NULL error_message.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-017 failed write rolls back logs Failed and re-raises]

conditions.description: Contact K4, 2025: the segment invoice has item code 'CONUNKNOWN', which is not in silv_ref_concession_type (RULE-052). anomaly_nk carries contact, year and item code; detail names year and invoice.
conditions.preconditions: K4: invoice 910401 INV-K4-25 (Card), lines SUBS 450.00 and CONUNKNOWN -100.00; paid 'Fully Paid'; attributes concession -1 Unrecognised, segment invoice 910401.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE, K4). Its anomaly_nk contains 'K4', '2025' and 'CONUNKNOWN'; its detail contains '2025' and 'INV-K4-25' or '910401'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-018 concession code not in the reference raises one CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE row naming the code]

conditions.description: Concession codes that are in the reference raise no CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE, whether full or reduced.
conditions.preconditions: K1: Full Concession invoice 910101 with SUBS 450.00 and CONRETIRED -450.00, Full Concession position, attributes concession Retired 2. K3: Fully Paid invoice 910301 with SUBS 450.00 and CONHARDSHIP -225.00, attributes concession Exceptional Hardship 3.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly is empty.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-019 concession codes found in the reference raise no CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE]

conditions.description: The same unknown concession code on two lines of one invoice is one case.
conditions.preconditions: K8: invoice 910801 with SUBS 450.00 and two CONUNKNOWN lines of -50.00; paid; attributes concession -1.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE, K8).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-020 the same unknown code on two lines raises one row]

conditions.description: Design: anomaly_nk for CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE includes the item code, so two different unknown codes on one invoice are two cases.
conditions.preconditions: K9: invoice 910901 with SUBS 450.00, CONUNKNOWN -50.00 and CONOTHER -50.00 (neither in the reference); paid; attributes concession -1.
conditions.expected: Exactly two rows, both (CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE, K9): one anomaly_nk contains 'CONUNKNOWN', the other 'CONOTHER'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-021 two different unknown codes on one invoice raise one row per code]

conditions.description: Contact K5 has a Full Concession position in 2025 and a segment invoice with no concession line (RULE-053).
conditions.preconditions: Full Concession position is set consistently in every source that can hold it: silv_payment_events invoice_position 'Full Concession', invoice payment_status 'Full Concession', full_concession_flag 'Y'. K5: invoice 910501 INV-K5-25 with one SUBS 450.00 line; attributes concession No concession 1.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION, K5); its anomaly_nk contains 'K5' and '2025', its detail '2025' and 'INV-K5-25' or '910501'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-022 Full Concession position with no concession line raises one FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION row]

conditions.description: A Full Concession position whose invoice carries only a reduced concession (Exceptional Hardship, discount 50) has no full-rate concession type, so it is flagged.
conditions.preconditions: K6: Full Concession position (all three sources as TC-008-022); invoice 910601 with SUBS 450.00 and CONHARDSHIP -225.00; attributes concession 3 (is_full_concession 0).
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION, K6).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-023 Full Concession position with only a reduced concession raises the row]

conditions.description: No FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION where the Full Concession invoice has a full-rate type (Retired, discount 100), or where the position is not Full Concession.
conditions.preconditions: K1: Full Concession position, invoice 910101 with CONRETIRED -450.00, attributes concession 2. K2: 'Fully Paid' position, payment_status 'Fully Paid', flag 'N', invoice 910201 with SUBS only, attributes No concession 1.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly is empty.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-024 full-rate concession or a non Full Concession position raises no FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION]

conditions.description: Across the synthetic set, every Full Concession position has either a full-rate concession type or a FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION row: 0 exceptions.
conditions.preconditions: K1 (Retired), K5 (no concession line) and K6 (Exceptional Hardship) with Full Concession positions; K2 with a Fully Paid position. Data as TC-008-022 to TC-008-024.
conditions.expected: 3 Full Concession positions; 0 of them have a non-full concession type and no anomaly row; exactly 2 FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION rows (K5, K6).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-025 every Full Concession position has a full-rate concession or an anomaly row]

conditions.description: A subscription row with a NULL Sub Status is not active, so it is not a live subscription and the Corporate segment invoice is flagged.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-002, Q-027. P18: invoice 901801 Corporate 2025; subscription SCH-018 2025 with sub_status NULL and sub_user_status 'Active', live in bronze; paid; attributes payment 5, payer Individual 1.
conditions.expected: silv_data_anomaly holds exactly one row: (CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, P18).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD008].[test TC-008-026 subscription with a NULL Sub Status is not live and the flag is raised]
